[[Totality Tower|Solar Eclipse Night IV]] |first_wave_appearance = 14 ([[Totality Tower]]) |base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]2,400 |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Average (3) |defense = {{Defense}}60% |spawned_by = *[[Penumbras]] *[[Lunar Servant]] |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = None }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Cursed Guard''' was an enemy that appeared in the third and fourth night of the [[Solar Eclipse Event]]. It was very similar to the [[Cobalt Guard (Solar Eclipse)|Cobalt Guard]], but had more health and defense than it. It did not appear naturally in [[Tower Outskirts]] and was instead spawned by [[Penumbras]]. In [[Totality Tower]] it appeared naturally and could be spawned by the [[Lunar Servant]]. ==Appearance== The '''Cursed Guard''' looked very similar to the [[Cobalt Guard (Solar Eclipse)|Cobalt Guard]]. It had dark purple skin. It wore a dark purple helmet, chestplate, leggings and shoulder-pads. It had purple arm bands with white glowing parts. Its eyes were neon white. It walked with a slight hunchback. ==Strategy== *Towers with high DPS are recommended, like the [[Accelerator]], [[Turret]], [[Minigunner]] or [[Ranger]]. **You can use the [[Commander]] to boost these towers' firerate. *Towers that deal full damage to defense enemies, like the [[Ace Pilot]] or the [[Pursuit]] can be useful against this. *You can also use towers that can reduce enemies' defense such as the [[Electroshocker]] and [[Pyromancer]] to weaken this enemy. **Do keep in mind that the [[Pyromancer]] will speed up this enemy by 15%. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Night Four - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Cursed Guard''' on a promotional video. }} ==Update History== *'''8 December 2021''' - [[v1.0.0]]d **'''Cursed Guard''' added. *'''13 December 2021''' - [[v1.0.0]]g **Now appears in [[Totality Tower]]. **Health increased from 1,800 to 2,400. **Defense increased from 30% to 60%. *'''26 January 2022''' - [[v1.0.1]] **'''Cursed Guard''' removed. {{TotalityTower|[[Cursed Knight]]|Wave 13|Cursed Guard, [[Flare]] & [[Cursed Horse]]|Wave 14|[[Lunar Shield]], [[Lunar Servant]] & [[Solar Servant]]|Wave 15}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Tower Outskirts]]
